semiconductor_relevance: High — ABSFIL specializes in filtration solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in the purification of ultrapure water and chemicals used in fabrication.
summary: ABSFIL designs and manufactures filter elements for liquids and gases, focusing on applications in the semiconductor industry. Their products are essential for ensuring the purity of ultrapure water and chemicals used in semiconductor processes, effectively removing ionic and colloidal contaminants.
capabilities: AbsMIR CS Ionic Metal Removal Filters for ultrapure water and chemicals
AbsMIR ESTM Particle Removal Filters for colloidal particles
AbsNON SS Nylon Membrane Filters for gel-like contaminants
